errors.text_span: with tick marks at integer values
errors.evidence: The labeled tick marks on the x-axis are at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, ...), not for every integer value. This phrasing is imprecise.

errors.text_span: rising to approximately 98% accuracy at an epoch of 30
errors.evidence: The Train line reaches 100% accuracy at epoch 27 and stays at 100% for the remainder of the plotted data (up to epoch 29). The value is not 98%.

errors.text_span: the line decreases to approximately 42% at epoch 18 before increasing again
errors.evidence: The Train (blue) line has an accuracy of approximately 80% at epoch 18. The description misidentifies both the location and value of a fluctuation; the most significant dip for the train line is to ~45% at epoch 11.
The green line representing the "Validation" dataset is solid, not dashed.

errors.text_span: a peak of approximately 68% at epoch 4
errors.evidence: The Validation (green) line has a value of approximately 61% at epoch 4, not 68%. The value 68% is closer to the Train line's accuracy at that epoch.

errors.text_span: a decline to approximately 40% at epoch 10
errors.evidence: The Validation (green) line has an accuracy of approximately 55% at epoch 10. The most significant decline for this line is to approximately 42% at epoch 11, not 40% at epoch 10.
